steps.if: the customer accepts a recommendation that includes a card and wants the card
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

steps.do: If the customer reports an error reply, tell them what it says (an invalid card_type reply lists the valid card names; an invalid annual_income reply asks for a number) and ask whether they want to resubmit with the corrected value. Otherwise confirm the application was submitted and that it goes through the credit check; do not promise approval.

basis.why: Taken from the replies listed in the apply_for_credit_card tool description; resubmitting is offered as a question to the customer.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit cards to see whether the new card now appears on the profile, and tell the customer.

steps.quote: The system identifies all active Rho-Bank credit cards linked to the customer's profile.

steps.do: If the customer asks you to open the recommended savings account, continue with opening_personal_savings_accounts using its full official account_class (e.g. 'Silver Plus Account').

steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account

basis.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Continue with opening_personal_checking_accounts using the recommended checking class's full official name.
steps.if: the customer accepted a recommended new checking account and asks for it to be opened
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: After the new accounts are open, continue with closing_personal_checking_accounts for the old checking account the customer wants closed.
steps.if: the customer also asked to close an old checking account
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

steps.do: If a lookup tool keeps returning a system error that blocks the recommendation, tell the customer, ask whether they want a human agent, and transfer only if they agree, using reason technical_system_error.

rules.rule: Never price a savings account whose ongoing minimum is above the balance the customer will keep. Below $10,000 a Gold Account is not in good standing, is charged $10.00 a month, and its rate eligibility can be affected.
rules.quote: Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.

basis.quote: Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
Falling below this amount can affect your eligibility for the highest rate.

rules.rule: A customer who needs paper statements cannot take Green Account (savings). Silver Plus and Silver offer paper statements at $0.00
rules.quote: Paperless statements are NOT required for this account (unlike Green Account (savings) which requires paperless).

rules.rule: Credit card APY bonuses do not add together. Only the highest one counts, including cards already held. They stack with checking boosts
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: A linked-checking boost applies only to the listed pairings; Light Blue checking is not in the list
rules.quote: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

rules.rule: Only the highest checking-account boost applies
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable checking account APY boost is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Worked comparison for this profile: deposit below $10,000 kept untouched for a year, paper statements required, credit score 680–719, no Rho-Bank+, refuses no-credit-check cards, keeps only a checking account not in a boost pairing and refuses a new one. Green (savings) is out because it is paperless, and Gold because its $10,000 ongoing minimum is above the deposit. Gold Plus and higher are out on opening deposit. EcoCard, Gold Rewards, Platinum and Diamond Elite are out. Silver Plus Account 3.0% + Bronze Rewards or Silver Rewards +0.15% = 3.15%, with a $0 fee and paper at $0.00. That beats Silver + Crypto-Cash Back (3.0% − $75), Silver + Silver Rewards (2.6%) and Bronze + Bronze Rewards (2.1% − $24 for paper). Bronze and Silver Rewards tie, so ask the customer to choose. Always recompute with the actual deposit.
rules.quote: | Bronze Rewards Card | +0.15% |

rules.rule: Worked comparison for a deposit of $500 up to $9,999 with no new checking, no Rho-Bank+, and e-statements fine: Green Account (savings) + Silver Rewards Card = 4.45% with a $0 fee. It beats Silver Plus + Bronze or Silver Rewards (3.15%) and Bronze + any card. Gold is out below its $10,000 minimum. Always recompute.
rules.quote: Silver Rewards Card: +0.45%

rules.rule: Worked comparison for a deposit of $10,000 up to about $25,000. The customer wants net = interest minus card fees, keeps only a checking account not paired with Silver or Gold, wants no new checking, has no Rho-Bank+ and no invitation, and is fine with e-statements. Silver Account 4.0% + EcoCard +2.2% = 6.2% less $50. That beats Gold + EcoCard (6.1% less $50), Gold + Silver Rewards (5.7%) and Silver Plus + EcoCard (4.95% less $50). Always recompute.
rules.quote: EcoCard: +2.2%

rules.rule: Worked comparison: about $25,000 kept for a year; new checking wanted with early direct deposit; the card must have travel insurance; under 62; no Rho-Bank+. Gold Account 5.5% + Green Account (checking) +0.75% + Silver Rewards +0.2% = 6.45%. Always recompute.
rules.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

rules.rule: Worked comparison: about $6,000 kept; wants a new checking; open to a card; age 27–61; no Rho-Bank+; e-statements fine. Evergreen Account + Green Account (savings) + Silver Rewards Card = 4.0% + 0.55% + 0.45% = 5.0%.
rules.quote: Link a Green Account (savings): +0.55% APY boost

rules.rule: Worked comparison: about $10,000 kept; savings must rebate ATM fees; the new checking must have overdraft protection; the card must have travel insurance. Gold Account 5.5% + Silver Rewards 0.2% = 5.7% with Blue Account (Blue gives Gold no boost).
rules.quote: ATM fee rebate cap per month: $30

rules.rule: Worked comparison: about $100,000 kept; new checking wanted; open to a card; age 27–61; no Rho-Bank+. Platinum Plus Account 7.0% + Purple Account +0.3% + Platinum Rewards Card +0.4% = 7.7%, so $7,700 − $200 = $7,500.
rules.quote: | APY boost with Platinum Plus Savings | +0.3% |

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. Every needed fact has been collected: deposit kept, statement need, credit score, card exclusions, Rho-Bank+, openness to a new checking account, and any withdrawal, fee or feature needs. One savings account + card pair has been recommended with its APY breakdown and yearly net. That pair adds one checking account when the customer wants one, or becomes a checking + savings pair when the customer declines a card. Alternatively, the customer has chosen between tied cards, or has been told no option fits and why. If the customer wanted the card, they applied with apply_for_credit_card or declined. If they asked for accounts to be opened, the work continues in opening_personal_savings_accounts.
